text:
mai: Heads-up: planning a small community push -- "Mini Refapp Workshop" next month. Need owners for short launch post, benchmark blurb, webinar tie-in, and routing. Quick volunteers?

derek: I can draft the launch post + two short code snippets. Keep it light and copy-first.

amelia: I'll run a single benchmark sweep using our harness and surface a hero stat plus a one-sentence explainers for non-devs.

raj: I'll do webinar ops and inbound mapping. Suggest registration -> tag in CRM -> autoresponder with refapp link + replay.

mai: Great. Requests: 1) Benchmark should compare default vs. batching on a 256-token demo and report median and p99. 2) Post needs an actionable CTA: "Clone the refapp and run in 5 mins." 3) Webinar format: 30m demo + 20m Q&A.

derek: Will include two CLI examples and a tiny GIF of the quickstart. GIF for LP hero.

amelia: Bench ask: 80 GPU minutes? Approve?

mai: Approved 80 minutes. Log under GH: mini-refapp-workshop.

raj: Routing: three email segments: trial users, community, maintainers. Maintainters get early review invite. Also add UTM params.

derek: Draft post ETA 48h. Will push PR to content repo.

amelia: I'll attach CSV + a small script so others can reproduce. Hero stat: "~35% cost reduction with batching and cache on interactive demos" if numbers hold.

mai: Keep language conservative: "up to ~35%" and link to reproducibles.

launch-bot: Reminder set: create GH issue "mini-refapp-workshop-playbook" and assign owners in 6 hours.

raj: I'll open the Eventbrite/reg form and cap at 250. Will wire registrants to the CRM via webhook.

mai: Owners recap: Derek=post & assets, Amelia=bench + reproducibles, Raj=webinar & routing. Please flag blockers before EOD. :rocket:
